newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread drops in weak brewing sector.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread drops in weak brewing sector.

text.p: Shares in the UK brewing sector continued to weaken on Thursday despite Monday's better-than-expected results from Whitbread Plc.
Whitbread was down 9p at 720 by 1614 GMT, Bass Plc was down 15-1/2p at 770 and Scottish & Newcastle Plc was down 13-1/2p at 634-1/2.
Analysts and traders said the declines in part reflected profit-taking and were mostly in line with the market trend, but they also reported some underlying concerns.

They said the strength of sterling could be eating into the value of overseas earnings in the sector and that there could be concerns about the future return on the investment plans Whitbread and others were pursuing.

"Despite the strength of Whitbread's results the market has begun to evaluate the company on the basis of the overall cost of capital relative to the return on their investments," said Fraser Ramzan, analyst at Lehman Brothers.
"The concern over the longer term is whether they will match the weighted average cost of capital and that on the longer term they will not deliever returns for shareholders."
Ramzan said he had an "outperform" rating on Whitbread since he expects Whitbread's investments to pay off.
